description:
Embrace the thrill of adventure with the Ape Ryder Buffalo F e-mountain bike, crafted for those who crave exploration and the beauty of nature. This bike elevates your riding experience, seamlessly combining performance and comfort for an unforgettable journey.
Key Features:
Sturdy 27.5” Alloy Frame: The Buffalo F features a lightweight yet robust alloy frame that excels on rugged terrains. Whether you're tackling steep hills or navigating uneven paths, this frame is built to conquer any challenge.
Powerful 36V 15Ah Samsung Battery: With a high-capacity battery, the Buffalo F provides the power you need for long-distance rides. Offering a range of 40-50 miles, you can enjoy the great outdoors without worrying about running out of juice.
Front Suspension with Lock-Out: Experience ultimate comfort with the front suspension designed to absorb shocks on bumpy surfaces. The lock-out feature allows for easier pedaling on flat terrains, helping you conserve energy for those uphill climbs.
Comfortable GEL Sport Saddle: Designed for long rides, the GEL sport saddle ensures maximum comfort on every pedal stroke, making it ideal for various terrains and distances.
Speed and Performance: Achieve speeds of up to 20 MPH, making this bike a perfect choice for thrill-seekers. With low energy consumption, you can enjoy longer journeys without sacrificing performance.
Kenda 26” x 4 Tires: The high-quality Kenda tires provide excellent traction and durability, ensuring a safe and reliable ride on diverse surfaces, from rocky trails to city streets.
Hydraulic Brake System: The hydraulic brakes offer reliable and effective stopping power, delivering quick responses in any condition. Designed for minimal maintenance, they ensure long-lasting performance.
Weight Capacity: With a maximum weight capacity of 297 lbs, the Buffalo F accommodates a variety of riders and gear, making it a versatile option for everyone.
The Ape Ryder Buffalo F is not just a bike; it's your companion for unforgettable adventures. Whether you're exploring mountain trails or cruising through urban landscapes, the Buffalo F is ready to join you on your journey. Are you ready to unlock the potential of your adventures?
Experience freedom with Ape Ryder. The Buffalo F is waiting for you!
